==Notes==
*The damage is dealt by the caster, not the target, which means it can trigger skills such as [[Pain Inverter]].
*[[Saccer]]s are known to use [[Signet of Agony]], [[Dark Aura]], and [[Contagion]] to force trigger Death Nova by sacrificing oneself to death.
*Consider using this skill with [[Putrid Flesh]] on allied [[minion]]s.
*This enchantment is also present as an [[environment effect]] in the fourth chamber of [[the Dragon's Lair]]. Both foes and allies are enchanted; however, the effect is quite weak (equal to 0 Death Magic).

==Trivia==
[[Image:Death Nova Beta Icon.jpg|thumb|64px|Beta icon]]
* In alpha this skill used the same icon as it does today. The icon used during beta did not see further in-game appearances.
* During early alpha, this skill functioned like a [[hex]] which dealt 20 damage to all nearby creatures when the target died, similar to [[Putrid Bile]] and [[Icy Veins]] today. It was classified as a "Necromancer Debuffing Skill" and used to cost 10 energy.
